title: Midori no Umi

guide_target.label: 翠の海 -midori no umi- ダウンロード版

routes.title: 共通
routes.notes: First playthrough from a new game. Set A (mono-iki) section 共通（BAD＆NORMAL） and Set B (愚者の館) シナリオ１ plus the common-route parts of シナリオ２ agree on every choice. Covers seven endings in Set A's order: ED Ⅱ 生かされ, ED Ⅳ 逃走, ED Ⅲ 殺人者, ED Ⅴ 狂気の中で, ED Ⅺ 赤い塔, ED Ⅹ 永遠の楽園 (みちるNORMAL) and the section terminal ED XIV 必要な人間 (共通NORMAL). Set B marks 灰奈と会話をする, 気のせいだ……、落ち着け…… and 知紗と勉強する as ◆ choices that appear only after specific endings, and places ED Ⅴ and ED Ⅺ in シナリオ２ (after any シナリオ１ ending). Set A's order satisfies those unlocks because ED Ⅱ and ED Ⅳ are reached first. Set A's 第4章 ★ choice 「平気」だと言って灰奈を安心させる appears only after 紡's ending and is skipped on this run (Set B does not mention it). Saves 1–8 follow Set A ①–⑧; Set B's 【セーブ１】【セーブ２】【セーブ３】【セーブ６】【セーブ４】【セーブ５】【セーブ８】 sit at the same positions as guide saves 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 7 and 8. Save 5 is Set A only. No portrait: section is not a single-character route.

routes.title: 真希奈 A
routes.notes: Set A: 共通NORMAL後にセーブポイント⑧から → 知紗の提案を断る → ED Ⅻ 幸せのため (真希奈A). Set B: after any シナリオ１ ending, load セーブ５ (= guide save 7) → 他に出来ることを探す →【セーブ８】→ 知紗の提案を断る → ◆気のせいだ。疲れているんだろう → ＥＮＤ１２. Set A says the ★ choice 気のせいだ。疲れているんだろう only appears after a 真希奈 ending, so on this first visit there is normally no second choice. Both sets agree on the ending. Portrait: VNDB c2844 真希奈, image.url https://t.vndb.org/ch/09/2909.jpg.

routes.title: 真希奈 B
routes.notes: Both sets: reload the save before 知紗の提案を断る after ED Ⅻ, then choose ……そうだ、真希奈は…… for ED XIII 永遠の幸せ. Set B states the explicit unlock: ＥＮＤ１２ plus any シナリオ２ ending (ED Ⅴ/Ⅺ from the common section qualify). Set A: 真希奈A ED後にセーブポイント⑧から. Split from makina_a because the deciding choice is not offered until ED Ⅻ has been seen.

routes.title: 陸乃＆空音
routes.notes: Set A: 真希奈ED後にセーブポイント④から → 灰奈と会話をしない → ⑨ → 双子に尋ねる → ⑩ → 空音を選ぶ → ED Ⅵ 瞬く星の下; optional: reload ⑩ and pick 陸乃を選ぶ for a scene variant (シーン差分回収). Set B シナリオ２: セーブ６ (= guide save 4) → 灰奈と会話をしない → ◆双子に尋ねる →【セーブ７】→ 空音を選ぶ → ＥＮＤ６; セーブ７から 陸乃を選ぶ = シーン回収. Set B marks the route-defining 双子に尋ねる with ◆ (appears only after a specific ending, unnamed in Set B); Set A names the requirement as 真希奈ED (Set A also states 一部シナリオに攻略制限がかかっている), so makina_a (ED Ⅻ, the first 真希奈 ending) is a prerequisite. The 陸乃を選ぶ scene collection has no ending terminal in either source, so it is described in enGuide rather than as steps after the terminal. Portrait: one portrait per section; VNDB c684 空音 image.url https://t.vndb.org/ch/16/27216.jpg (陸乃 is c685, https://t.vndb.org/ch/19/27219.jpg).

routes.title: 沙羅
routes.notes: Set A: 陸乃＆空音ED後にセーブポイント⑨から → 沙羅に尋ねる → ED Ⅶ 護るべき者の隣で. Set B シナリオ３ (after any シナリオ２ ending): セーブ６から → 灰奈と会話をしない → 沙羅に尋ねる → ＥＮＤ７. Guide save 9 sits directly after 灰奈と会話をしない, so loading it is equivalent. Portrait: VNDB c2843 沙羅.

routes.title: 灰奈
routes.notes: Set A: 陸乃＆空音ED後にセーブポイント⑥から → 自分の記憶と憎悪を受け入れる → ⑪ → 全てを受け入れて、ここで生きる → ED Ⅷ 解けない魔法. Set B シナリオ３: セーブ４から (same position as guide save 6) → 自分の記憶と憎悪を受け入れる → ◆全てを受け入れて、ここで生きる → ＥＮＤ８. Save 11 is Set A only and is reused by the 知紗 section. Portrait: VNDB c686 灰奈.

routes.title: 紡
routes.notes: Set A: 陸乃＆空音ED後にセーブポイント⑥から → 夢の内容を現実と受け入れる → ⑫ → 紡を無視する = ED Ⅰ 青い鳥のため (共通みちるBAD); reload ⑫ → 扉を開けてやる → ED Ⅸ 幸せの茨道. Set B: ＥＮＤ１ via ◆紡を無視する in シナリオ１ and ＥＮＤ９ via 扉を開けてやる in シナリオ３, both from セーブ４ (= guide save 6). Set A places ED Ⅰ here instead of in the first run; Set B's ◆ marker means it may not be offered on a first run, so Set A's later placement is safe. Save 12 is Set A only. Portrait: VNDB c687 紡.

routes.title: 知紗
routes.notes: Set A: 紡ED後にセーブポイント⑪から → これ以上を望んで、別な道を探す → ⑬ → 知紗に全てを話す → ED XV 踏み出した道. Set B シナリオ４ (after any シナリオ３ ending): セーブ４から → 自分の記憶と憎悪を受け入れる → これ以上を望んで、別な道を探す →【セーブ９】→ 知紗に全てを話す → ＥＮＤ１５. Requires save 11 from the 灰奈 section; Set A requires 紡's ending first. Portrait: VNDB c683 知紗.

routes.title: みちる
routes.notes: Final ending. Set A: 紡ED後にセーブポイント⑬から → 知紗に何も話さない → ED XVI 翼広げて (みちるTRUE). Set B: セーブ９から → 知紗に何も話さない → ＥＮＤ１６. Requires guide save 13 from the 知紗 section. Portrait: VNDB c682 来栖みちる.

sources.title: 翠の海-midori no umi-攻略チャート【ゲーム完全攻略】
sources.notes: Set A; complete Japanese chart for the Cabbit Windows release (no patch: 修正パッチ：なし), covering all 16 endings with 13 numbered save points ①–⑬ and the recommended order 共通BAD→みちるNORMAL→真希奈→陸乃＆空音→沙羅→灰奈→紡→知紗→みちるTRUE. Directly fetched as HTML. Exact step, save, load and ending text (ED：Ⅰ–XVI labels) are quoted from this page. Note that the load text for save 10 uses ➉ (U+2789) rather than ⑩ in the source.

sources.title: 翠の海 攻略 by 愚者の館（アーカイブ）
sources.notes: Set B; independent Japanese walkthrough by mon, checked against the unpatched Cabbit release (確認バージョン：修正なし, last updated 2011/11/07, CG・回想１００％). Organised as シナリオ１–４ unlock tiers with nine saves and all sixteen endings (ＥＮＤ１–１６). Directly fetched (Shift_JIS). Independently supports every route-defining choice, unlock tier and ending in the guide. Uses ◆ for choices that only appear after specific endings.

disagreements: Target: VNDB lists r14379 (2011-10-28 package) and r18372 (2011-12-02 download edition) as the only official complete Japanese releases; later 2019 official release r58870 has no Japanese text. r18372 is the newest applicable release and carries the same content; both sources were written for the unpatched Cabbit Windows game. Cover: r18372's digital cover image on VNDB is https://t.vndb.org/cv/99/81699.jpg. Save numbering: the guide uses Set A's thirteen positions (1–13 = ①–⑬); Set B's nine saves coincide with Set A positions where both exist, so no earlier-position conflicts arise. Loads where Set B reloads a different (earlier) save and replays choices use the Set B omission placeholder. Ending order: Set B places ED Ⅰ in its first run and ED Ⅴ/Ⅺ in its second; Set A places ED Ⅴ/Ⅺ in the common pass after ED Ⅱ/Ⅳ (satisfying Set B's unlock tier) and ED Ⅰ in the 紡 section. Conditional choices: Set A says the ★ choice 気のせいだ。疲れているんだろう appears only after a 真希奈 ending; Set B marks it ◆ (appears after a specific ending) without naming which ending. The sources do not contradict each other and agree on the outcome, so the guide follows Set A's order and explains the choice in enGuide. Set A's ★「平気」だと言って灰奈を安心させる (only after 紡's ending, before save 6) is not reached again in Set A's order and is omitted. Optional 陸乃を選ぶ scene variant (both sets) has no ending, so it is described in enGuide. enGuide text is a translation of the Set A/Set B notes; no English walkthrough was used.
